subtitle: Lesson 25 · MID Server & On-Premises Integration

steps.label: Discovery
steps.sub: scans the customer's internal network to find and catalog CIs, populating the CMDB

steps.label: Orchestration
steps.sub: runs automation against on-prem systems the cloud instance has no network path to

steps.label: Relay
steps.sub: routes a REST Message or IntegrationHub action to an internal-only system

code:
Configured the same way as Ch. 2-5:
REST Message / connector action
  -> same auth profile
  -> same endpoint record

Only this changes:
"Connection & Credential" alias
  -> now points to a specific MID Server
  -> the real HTTP call fires from inside
     the customer's network, not SN's cloud
caption: The integration itself never changes. Only the routing does.

eyebrow: Discovery and Orchestration need the same thing
code:
ServiceNow's cloud                 Customer's own network
+----------------+                 +---------------------------+
|  SN instance   |                 |  MID Server               |
|  queues the    | <== outbound == |  - runs Discovery scans   |
|  job           |     polling     |  - executes Orchestration |
+----------------+                 |  - relays REST calls      |
                                    +---------------------------+
caption: Same MID Server, same outbound poll — three different jobs it can pick up.
